sanskrit_verse:
विहाय चरिताचारं यत्र कुर्यात् पुनर्नृपः ।
निर्णयं सा तु राजाज्ञा चरितं बाध्यते तया ॥
transliteration: vihāya caritācāraṃ yatra kuryāt punar nṛpaḥ | nirṇayaṃ sā tu rājājñā caritaṃ bādhyate tayā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Where a king, having abandoned proper conduct, acts again contrary to dharma, his prior decree loses validity by that very act.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority erodes with violation of dharma
Causation arises from alignment with sanatana dharma
Capacity-based responsibility is contingent upon sustained dharmic intent
Restoration logic demands invalidation of prior acts rooted in adharma
Consciousness alignment determines the continuing legitimacy of command
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler's action violates established dharma THEN previous rulings issued by same ruler are automatically suspended for review
IF ruler demonstrates repeated deviation from dharma THEN all active decrees must undergo realignment audit
IF decree causes dissonance in societal harmony THEN it shall be nullified without punitive consequence
IF ruler fails to uphold svadharma THEN capacity for authoritative issuance is temporarily withdrawn
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when executive or judicial authority has repeatedly violated foundational dharma, prior judgments or orders issued under such compromised capacity lose automatic enforceability until reviewed through a consciousness-based integrity protocol.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that misaligned action invalidates prior claims to truth; anupūrvaśaḥ shows how deviation leads to loss of authority; proportional responsibility lies in restoring correctness rather than inflicting penalty; reality remains non-punitive as consciousness itself corrects imbalance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process to restore original dharmic framework
Engage ruler in svadharma re-alignment through sankalpa-based practice
Re-validate all affected rulings post-consciousness recalibration
Implement collective harmony assessment before re-authorizing decree enforcement
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling flows directly from Sanatana Dharma. Justice serves only restoration. Reality holds no punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
